posts.text: I’m hearing that some members are upset about the blowback they’re receiving from their constituents for voting against the amendment to remove pesticide liability protections. I have absolutely nothing to do with that. I don’t control activists, influencers, outside groups, or anyone else, and it’s a pretty big cop-out to suggest otherwise. Newsflash: people are genuinely upset that this provision was added to the Farm Bill and that it would have given liability protections to pesticide compani

TY NICOLE!


Rep. Nicole Malliotakis Office (@RepNicole)

Happy to support this MAHA amendment so Monsanto and other pesticide companies are not shielded from liability. The bipartisan group that voted for it are putting people’s health above pesticide companies’ profits. washingtonexaminer.com/news/…





— https://nitter.net/RepNicole/status/2049942554276196862#m

Great video Hannah, so true!

Video

🥹 It’s all love and MAHA 🫶🏼


Alex Clark (@yoalexrapz)

BOW DOWN 👑👸🏻 @RepLuna has officially been dubbed the MAHA queenie





— https://nitter.net/yoalexrapz/status/2049892784182587732#m
My amendment passed! Pesticide liability protections have been stripped from the farm bill. 🔥⚔️🔥

I do not support giving blanket immunity to corporations at the expense of American families. Pesticides are linked to a 30% increase in childhood cancer and over 170 studies corroborate the evidence. 

This amendment ensures we stand on the side of the American people and the health of our nation, not corporate interests.

Always happy to reach across the aisle when we can work together on behalf of what’s best for the American people.


Congresswoman Chellie Pingree (@chelliepingree)

WE DID IT 👏🏻

The @RepLuna Amendment passed and we successfully got the industry-written pesticide liability language OUT of the FARM BILL. 

I’ll be clear: this is still a terrible bill. But counting the wins where we can.

Video
  







— https://nitter.net/chelliepingree/status/2049865019840463176#m

Thank you!!!! @RepMikeCollins


Rep. Mike Collins (@RepMikeCollins)

Americans have the right to eat real, healthy food, free of cancer-causing pesticides and herbicides. 

Today, I voted to strip toxic chemicals from Americans’ food! It’s common sense.



— https://nitter.net/RepMikeCollins/status/2049868311391773114#m
